description: For one of the employer's jobs: the facts that hold it back and what to do, most useful first. Pay against the pay listed in ads for the same job title (the job page's own pay check, with the number of ads behind it), how many live job alerts on Jobiba match the job (a count only; never who; null below 5), whether the title is one with its own page in that country, applicants so far, and the ad-text checks. No score. Report the findings as given and never add a number that is not in the result.

jobId.description: Jobiba job ID (the id field from search_jobs or list_my_jobs).
